decisive_items: Neck ultrasound failed to identify the thyroid gland in its normal pretracheal location
several adjacent 1 cm nodular structures enhanced similarly to thyroid tissue, and no thyroid gland was seen in the usual neck location
response.rationale: Ectopic thyroid tissue is more likely due to the presence of multiple nodular structures enhancing similarly to thyroid tissue and the absence of a normal thyroid gland in the neck

rejected.why: Thyroglossal duct cyst is less likely as it does not typically present with multiple nodular structures or the absence of a normal thyroid gland
